title: Garaschuk's conjecture on fractional triangle decompositions
statement: Let $G$ be a graph with $n$ vertices and minimum degree at least $\frac{3}{4}n$. **Garaschuk's conjecture.** If $n$ is large enough, then $G$ is fractionally $K_3$-decomposable. Fractional triangle decomposability is a relaxation of an actual triangle decomposition, and this conjecture would provide the fractional decomposition threshold needed in approaches to Nash-Williams' conjecture. The source presents it as a conjecture and identifies Garaschuk's result as the best known result towards Nash-Williams' conjecture, so its resolution status should be checked against the cited work.
source_name: François Dross, “Fractional triangle decompositions in graphs with large minimum degree”, arXiv:1503.08191 (2015).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.08191

Status: **solved** according to the source (as of March 2015). “The best known result towards proving Conjecture was established by Garaschuk .”
